title: Open-problem database source
description: Attribution and provenance for one upstream family collection. Every family record traces to exactly one of these. Credit is a gate, not a courtesy: a source without complete attribution does not validate.

maintainers.description: People or groups to name when this collection is cited.

license.description: Upstream licence identifier, or a short phrase when the site states no formal licence.

statement.description: One sentence naming who built the collection.

requested_citation.description: How the upstream project asks to be cited, quoted or paraphrased from its own instructions.

policy.description: pointer-only: link plus a short quoted evidence line. metadata-only: also structured fields the upstream licence permits. full-mirror: upstream content copied wholesale.

caveats.description: Limits the upstream project states about its own data, carried forward rather than dropped.
